slots.S50: (iter7GG2, T1, w, k), w in W1-W5, k in 0-9 (iteration 7's dose-sweep streams)
slots.HT30: (iter7GG2, T1, w, k), w in W4-W5, k in 10-24 (new streams)

edits.DAS: f(h) = h + lam R_k (c_Y - R_k^T h), R_k = das_L17_seed0[:, :k]; c_Y = commit3 class means (rank 4) and their first k coordinates for k < 4; other seeds/ranks: the same mean recomputed on this engine
edits.DiM: f(h) = h + beta u, u = dim_L17; beta re-bisected on this engine to the mean teacher-forced dy of DAS r4 lam 1 over the 72 train bases (grid scan first)
edits.RAND: Rr = qr(randn(2560, 4, seed 31337)); c_rand = mean Rr^T h over BFS train sources; lam 1
edits.REV-DAS: forced F5 BFS + c*: h' = h + R_4 (R_4^T h_tw(w) - R_4^T h) at p_f
edits.REV-FULL: forced F5 BFS + c*: h' = h_tw(w) at p_f
edits.prefilled: applied at p_f during the prefill of prompt + c*
edits.free: The edit f acts on the block-17 output of row b at the decode step whose INPUT token is response index i_d - 1 (its logits choose token i_d); the edited state persists in the KV cache.

design.decoding: T 1.0, top-p 1, no top-k, max_new 1024, fence stop, exact inverse-CDF CRN (stream index = response index), fixed batch shape 25

decision_rules.P1: G1a (forced-BFS F5 + c* prefilled, no edit, S50): correct BFS >= 40/50.
decision_rules.P1b: P-DAS-bfs vs G1a on correct BFS, two-sided exact McNemar over the 50 CRN slots: p >= 0.05 -> 'MATCHES (not distinguishable at N = 50)'; p < 0.05 with more DAS correct -> 'DIAL BEATS MATCHED PROMPTING'; p < 0.05 with fewer -> 'DIAL LOSES TO MATCHED PROMPTING'.
decision_rules.P2: F-DAS-r4-bfs-1.0: correct BFS >= 30/50 AND pass >= 0.8 x F-twin pass AND correct BFS > F-twin (one-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05). Holds -> 'free-generation knob'; fails -> 'the dial works only with a teacher-forced prefill'.
decision_rules.P3: Reach share (R1 or R2) over the 50 F-twin slots >= 0.80; R1 share about 0.86.
decision_rules.P4: On R1 slots, free and prefilled programs agree on label in >= 0.90 of slots, for the twin pair (F-twin vs P-twin) and the DAS pair (F-DAS-r4-bfs-1.0 vs P-DAS-bfs); (label, pass) agreement and byte-identical code shares are reported beside it.
decision_rules.P5: Dormancy reported either way; the D5/K2 account predicts reverse recovery >= 0.5 and retention >= 0.5 at k = 4; iteration-7 numbers predict LOW_NATURAL_VARIANCE at k = 1, 2, 4.
decision_rules.P7: |TF-predicted attempted-BFS share - observed attempted-BFS share| <= 0.10 in every prefilled cell (P-twin, P-DAS-bfs, P-DAS-dfs, G1a, G1b).
decision_rules.G2_HOLM: The 4 free DAS toward-BFS cells vs F-twin, one-sided exact McNemar on correct BFS, Holm.
decision_rules.DECISION_POSITION: R1: F-twin tokens[0:32] == c* -> i_d = 32. R2: else the first i in [8, 96] with tokens[i-1] == c*[31] (body-indent token), p_B(i) + p_D(i) >= 0.5, p_D(i) >= 0.01 and no algorithm-identifying string (deque, queue, visited, stack, heapq, heappush, popleft, pop(0), dfs, bfs, recurs; case-insensitive) in decode(tokens[0:i]). Else NOT_REACHED (no edit; intention to treat). Diagnostic only: the literal rule (first i <= 96 with p_B + p_D >= 0.5).
decision_rules.FREE_EDIT: The edit f acts on the block-17 output of row b at the decode step whose INPUT token is response index i_d - 1 (its logits choose token i_d); the edited state persists in the KV cache.
decision_rules.REVERSE_RECOVERY: reverse recovery_k = mean(dm_das) / mean(dm_full) over (base, source) pairs, bases = forced-BFS F4/F5 x 4 display pairs + c*, sources = the 24 twin variants of the aligned template (W4<->F4, W5<->F5); UNDEFINED if |mean dm_full| < 0.5 nat (then the absolute DAS reverse is reported against 50 Haar rank-k subspaces). Base-clustered bootstrap CI.
decision_rules.RETENTION: retention_k = mean dy_dir(R_proj) / mean dy_dir(R_k) over iteration 7's 768 held-out forward pairs, R_proj = qr(U64 U64^T R_k), U64 = top-64 PCs of the 120 twin-variant block-17 p_f states.
decision_rules.FORWARD_RECOVERY: iteration 7's statistic: median over held-out pairs with |dy_full| >= 1 of dy / dy_full (seed 0 for the rule; seed median reported).
decision_rules.DORMANT_FLAG: (retention_k < 0.5 OR reverse recovery_k < 0.5) AND forward recovery_k >= 0.8 [art_veI9l_Rb9wDY rule].
decision_rules.LOW_NATURAL_VARIANCE: share_k <= the 95th percentile of 1,000 Haar rank-k subspaces.
decision_rules.VERDICT: DORMANT/OFF-MANIFOLD HANDLE if DORMANT_FLAG; else UNDETERMINED if the reverse ratio is UNDEFINED; else SUFFICIENT, LOW-VARIANCE if LOW_NATURAL_VARIANCE; else USED VARIABLE.
decision_rules.RESTORATION_GEN: (correct DFS(REV-DAS) - correct DFS(G1a)) / (correct DFS(REV-FULL) - correct DFS(G1a)) on S30; UNDEFINED if the denominator <= 2 programs.

predictions.P1b: P-DAS-bfs vs G1a two-sided McNemar p >= 0.05 (matches)
predictions.P2: F-DAS-r4-bfs-1.0 correct BFS >= 30/50, pass >= 0.8 x F-twin, > F-twin
predictions.P4: R1-slot label agreement >= 0.90 (twin and DAS pairs)
predictions.P5: account: reverse recovery >= 0.5 and retention >= 0.5 at k = 4; iteration 7: LOW_NATURAL_VARIANCE at k = 1, 2, 4
predictions.P7: TF-predicted attempted BFS within 0.10 of observed in every prefilled cell
